Container.Name: cleanarr
Container.Overview:
Adds a second audio track, "Cleaned - English", to shows and movies from Sonarr and Radarr, with the profanity muted. One file, extra track: the original audio is untouched and stays the default, and the clean one is picked from the audio menu in Plex.
Built locally from /mnt/user/appdata/cleanarr-src - rebuild with: cd /mnt/user/appdata/cleanarr-src/docker && docker compose up -d --build
Container.Requires: An NVIDIA GPU, Sonarr and Radarr, and Ollama for the second opinion on ambiguous words.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings, the job database and the cached transcripts.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Must be mounted at the SAME path Sonarr and Radarr use, or the file paths they report will not resolve here.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: The GPU used to transcribe. 'all', or a specific GPU UUID from nvidia-smi -L.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: What the container may use the driver for.
